content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req_seg_rev_query\",\"kind\":\"query\",\"description\":\"FY2024 (year ended June 30, 2024) segment revenue for Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud and More Personal Computing, as disclosed in both the FY2024 10-K (original) and the FY2025 10-K (recast); retain unit and source version for each record.\",\"query\":{\"records\":[{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019-dimensions-8781118eeaf71322\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"},{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019-dimensions-08727d67db4596da\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"},{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019-dimensions-5b1b9c3c62f8d7a7\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"}]}},{\"requirement_id\":\"req_fy2024_10k_text\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-8602d79f703e48c18c2f27c3\",\"description\":\"FY2024 10-K original segment revenue table (units in millions, year ended June 30, 2024) with its introduction and any text about segment presentation, as originally reported.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req_fy2025_10k_text\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"FY2025 10-K segment revenue table showing recast FY2024 figures (units, periods) plus original text explaining the August 2024 segment composition change and recast of prior period information, so differences are not read as natural growth.\"}]","reason":"Plan requirements covering numeric segment revenue in both filings and original explanatory text for the recast.","requirement_ids":[]}
